idea_versions.name: Krishi Saathi
idea_versions.summary: A voice-first helper for small farmers in Odisha that turns Odia or Hindi voice notes (plus a photo) into a likely crop-disease diagnosis, simple next steps, the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra contact, and a KALIA scheme eligibility check.
idea_versions.userProblem: Many small farmers do not type, so text-based tools are hard for them to use when they need help with crop problems such as yellowing paddy leaves.
idea_versions.targetAudience: Small farmers in Odisha who speak Odia or Hindi and prefer voice over typing.
idea_versions.workflow: The farmer records a voice note in Odia or Hindi describing the problem (e.g., 'paddy leaves are turning yellow') and adds a photo. The app converts the voice note to text and uses it together with the photo to suggest a possible crop disease. It then explains the next step in simple language, provides the phone number of the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra, and checks whether the farmer is eligible for the KALIA scheme.
features: Voice note input in Odia or Hindi
Speech-to-text conversion of voice notes
Possible crop disease identification using the voice note and a photo
Next-step guidance in simple language
Nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra phone number
KALIA scheme eligibility check
WhatsApp-like web interface
differentiators: Voice-first design for farmers who do not type
Combines disease guidance, local KVK contact, and KALIA eligibility in one flow
idea_versions.originalPitch: Mera idea hai Krishi Saathi — Odisha ke chhote kisaano ke liye ek voice-first helper. Bahut saare kisaan typing nahi karte, toh woh Odia ya Hindi mein voice note bolte hain, jaise 'dhaan ke patte peele ho rahe hain'. App us voice note ko text mein badalta hai, ek photo ke saath possible fasal ki bimari batata hai, simple language mein agla step samjhata hai, aur nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra ka number deta hai. Saath mein yeh bhi check karta hai ki kisaan KALIA scheme ke liye eligible hai ya nahi. Pehla version ek simple web app hoga jo WhatsApp jaisa dikhega, Next.js aur ek AI model ke saath.

architecture.storage: No database; static JSON for KVK directory, KALIA rules, and cached demo responses in the repo.
architecture.frontend: Next.js App Router + Tailwind, mobile-first chat UI; MediaRecorder for audio, canvas-based image compression, browser speechSynthesis/TTS optional.
security: API keys only in server env vars
Request size limits and a 30s audio cap
Basic per-IP rate limiting on AI routes
No storage of farmer audio or photos; disclaimers on medical-style advice

risks.mitigation: Build it early and keep a fallback path.
risks.description: Speech-to-text for Odia/Hindi: Hindi is widely supported. Odia support and accuracy vary by provider. Options include OpenAI Whisper (Odia accuracy reportedly weak), Google Cloud Speech-to-Text (verify the official API for the or-IN locale), and AI4Bharat IndicConformer or Bhashini, which are Indic-focused; verify the official API and access process for Bhashini. Test with real Odia audio early.

risks.id: int_Multimodal LLM for image + text diagnosis
risks.mitigation: Build it early and keep a fallback path.
risks.description: Multimodal LLM for image + text diagnosis: Use a hosted vision-capable model such as GPT-4o-class or Gemini-class. Prompt it to return structured JSON with likely conditions, confidence, simple next steps and a referral to a KVK. Outputs must be framed as suggestions rather than diagnoses. Generating Odia text output is feasible but needs native-speaker review.

risks.mitigation: Build it early and keep a fallback path.
risks.description: KALIA eligibility check: There is no confident public eligibility API, so verify the official API before relying on one. Implement a rule-based questionnaire built from published scheme criteria (land size or landless status, cultivator category, income-tax payer and government-employee exclusions, etc.). Show a disclaimer and link to the official portal. Rules may have changed, so cite the source date.

build_tasks.title: Scaffold Next.js app and deploy skeleton to Vercel
build_tasks.description: Create a Next.js (App Router, TypeScript) repo, add env placeholders for STT and LLM keys, create /api/health route, and deploy to Vercel so the public URL exists from day one. Obtain the LLM and STT API keys in this block.
build_tasks.acceptance: Public Vercel URL loads a placeholder 'Krishi Saathi' page; /api/health returns 200; keys are set as Vercel env vars and not committed to git.

build_tasks.title: Record voice notes in the browser (Odia/Hindi selector)
build_tasks.description: Build a hold-to-record mic button using MediaRecorder, with a language toggle (ଓଡ଼ିଆ / हिंदी). Cap clips at 30s, show a timer and playback, and handle webm (Android Chrome) and mp4 (iOS Safari) formats. Add a text-input fallback.
build_tasks.acceptance: On Android Chrome, a 10s clip can be recorded, played back and uploaded to the server as a blob under 1MB; the language choice is sent with it; denied mic permission shows the text fallback.

build_tasks.title: Server-side speech-to-text with editable transcript
build_tasks.description: Create /api/transcribe, which proxies audio to the chosen STT provider (Hindi guaranteed, Odia best-effort; test Google or-IN, Whisper and Bhashini/AI4Bharat with real clips first). Return the transcript to the UI so the farmer can confirm or edit it.
build_tasks.acceptance: A recorded Hindi clip 'धान की पत्तियां पीली हो रही हैं' is transcribed recognisably. Odia accuracy on 5 test clips is logged in a notes file. The transcript is editable before submission, and errors return a friendly retry message.

build_tasks.title: Multimodal diagnosis from transcript + photo
build_tasks.description: Add photo attach/capture with client-side compression (max ~1024px, under 500KB). Create /api/diagnose, which sends the transcript and image to a vision LLM with a prompt that returns strict JSON: {possibleIssues:[{name,confidence}], nextSteps[], urgency, disclaimer}. Validate the response with zod.
build_tasks.acceptance: For 5 rice-leaf disease sample images plus the description, the API returns valid JSON with at least one plausible issue. Malformed model output is retried or rejected gracefully. The response is labelled 'possible', not a definitive diagnosis.

build_tasks.title: Simple-language next steps in the farmer's language
build_tasks.description: Render the diagnosis as three short, numbered steps in Odia or Hindi at a low reading level. Avoid specific pesticide doses and always recommend confirming with the KVK. Show a safety disclaimer, and add browser TTS playback if available.
build_tasks.acceptance: The reply is in the selected language, has 3 or fewer steps of 20 words or fewer each, and includes a disclaimer and KVK referral. No chemical dosage appears across 5 test runs.

build_tasks.title: Nearest KVK lookup by district with tap-to-call
build_tasks.description: Hand-compile data/kvk.json with all Odisha districts → KVK name, address and phone from ICAR/OUAT listings, with the source and date noted. Add a district dropdown (labels in Odia and Hindi) that shows the KVK card with a tel: link.
build_tasks.acceptance: All ~30 Odisha districts are present. Selecting Cuttack shows the correct KVK and phone. Tapping the number opens the dialer on a phone. The JSON passes a schema check script.

build_tasks.title: Rule-based KALIA eligibility questionnaire
build_tasks.description: Encode the published KALIA criteria (small/marginal cultivator or landless, exclusions for income-tax payers and government employees, etc.) in lib/kalia.ts as a pure function. Ask 4–6 yes/no questions with voice-friendly icons. Show the result with a disclaimer, the source date, and a link to the official KALIA portal.
build_tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover at least 6 profiles (eligible small farmer, landless, taxpayer excluded, government employee excluded, etc.) and all pass. The UI shows Eligible / Likely not eligible / Check with office, plus the official link.

build_tasks.title: WhatsApp-like chat UI tying the flow together
build_tasks.description: Build a mobile-first chat thread: user bubbles (audio, photo, transcript) and bot bubbles (diagnosis, steps, KVK card, KALIA prompt). Add a sticky bottom bar with mic, camera and text input, and a 'Demo: yellow paddy leaves' button that loads pre-recorded inputs and a cached response.
build_tasks.acceptance: The full flow from voice + photo through diagnosis, KVK card and KALIA result completes in a single chat thread on a 360px-wide screen. The demo button runs the flow offline from cached data in under 3s.

build_tasks.title: Real-world test of the end-to-end flow and fix breakages
build_tasks.description: Run the flow on an Android phone with 5 Odia and 5 Hindi clips and 10 crop photos, and ideally with one Odia speaker or farmer. Log STT accuracy, diagnosis plausibility, latency and bugs in TESTING.md, and fix the top issues.
build_tasks.acceptance: TESTING.md lists at least 10 runs with results and fixes. No blocking bugs remain on the main flow. The median end-to-end latency is recorded.

build_tasks.title: Finalize and submit the working project link
build_tasks.description: Verify the production deployment, the env keys and the demo button. Add a README with a description, setup steps, limitations and data sources (KVK, KALIA).
build_tasks.acceptance: The production URL works in an incognito mobile browser, the README is complete, and the link is submitted on the hackathon form.

build_tasks.title: Record and submit a 2–3 minute demo video
build_tasks.description: Script: the problem (farmers who don't type), then a live Odia/Hindi voice note and photo, diagnosis, simple steps, KVK call link and KALIA check, then test evidence and limitations. Record the phone screen with voiceover.
build_tasks.acceptance: The video is 3 minutes or shorter, shows the full flow working on the deployed URL, is uploaded publicly or unlisted, and the link is submitted.

demo_plans.hook: Many small farmers in Odisha don't type, so text-based crop tools are hard for them to use. Krishi Saathi is being designed so they can just speak.

segments.title: The Problem
segments.onScreen: Photo or illustration of a paddy field with yellowing leaves; caption: 'Many small farmers do not type.'
segments.narration: Imagine a small farmer in Odisha noticing his paddy leaves turning yellow. He speaks Odia, he prefers voice to typing, and most crop-help tools expect him to type. When he needs help most, those tools are hard for him to use.

segments.title: Who It's For
segments.onScreen: Text slide: 'For small farmers in Odisha · Odia & Hindi speakers · Voice over typing'
segments.narration: Krishi Saathi is aimed at small farmers in Odisha who speak Odia or Hindi and would rather send a voice note than write a message. The idea is to meet them in a familiar, chat-style experience.

segments.title: Where We Are
segments.onScreen: Slide: 'Build in progress — live demo coming once the first feature works.'
segments.narration: We haven't built any part of the app yet, so instead of a mock demo, we're showing the problem we're solving and who we're solving it for. Once the first working piece is ready, we'll show it here running live, along with real feedback from farmers.

segments.onScreen: Krishi Saathi name and tagline: 'Speak your problem.' plus a contact or feedback link
segments.narration: Our goal is to make crop help possible for farmers who speak, not type. We'd love your feedback on what to build first.
